author: evac
description: Ambient anime-character card collecting. Cards drop as the channel talks; each card in a drop has its own 5-character CAPTCHA code burned into its art. Press the drop's Claim button, type a code into the pop-up, and the first correct code claims that card -- so you have to actually read the card, not just react fastest. Collect, trade, sell duplicates for wondercoin, and build a gallery.
install_msg: Thanks for installing cardcollect! Set a drop channel with `.card setchannel #channel`, then bulk-import a starter character pool with `.card importpool <count>` (pulls female AniList characters spread across rarity tiers to match drop_weights, not just the most-favourited ones; safe to re-run, it skips characters already in the pool, paces its own requests, and retries automatically if AniList rate-limits it -- but only run one `.card importpool` at a time, a second one just queues behind the first) or add your own one at a time with `.card addcard`. Turn on `.card testmode true` and try `.card testdrop` before going live -- test claims run the full mechanic but award nothing. Claiming works through a single **Claim a card** button under each drop: press it, type the short CAPTCHA code burned onto whichever card you want into the pop-up, and the first correct code wins that card (one card per member per drop). Every reply is private to the member (ephemeral), and nothing is typed into chat. A member gets 2 *wrong but code-shaped* guesses per drop (`.card set wrongguesses`; a typo that doesn't even look like a code is free and just gets a hint) -- using them up locks them out of that drop, and out of winning *any* drop for a while (`.card set wrongguesspenalty`, default 120s). Unclaimed drops stop accepting codes after `.card set dropexpiry` (default 600s). Members get a daily claim quota (`.card set claimquota`, default 10/day, 0 = unlimited), a `.card info <card>` lookup, and up to 3 showcase slots (`.card showcase add/remove`) in their gallery -- `.card` and `.card showcase` also take an optional @member to view someone else's. Each member can hold one tradeable spare of any character (a second copy, giftable with `.card give`); a 3rd claim of the same card auto-converts to a sell token instead of piling up duplicates. Run `.card diagnostics` after a few days live to get real sizing suggestions for drop_chance/drop_cooldown_seconds instead of guessing.
short: Ambient anime-character card collecting with a button-and-code claim mechanic.
name: cardcollect
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per member, their card collection, favorite card, and pending sell tokens. This data is stored locally in the bot's data folder and is not shared externally.
